title: AP-CUR-13 Currency Rate
summary: Ledgerline screen for retrieving, listing, and maintaining foreign currency conversion rates to GBP.
body:
Screen AP-CUR-13 maintains foreign currency exchange rates against GBP in Ledgerline Accounts Payable [^r1][^r13]. Accessed via Accounts payable > Currency rate, it allows authorised roles to look up, record, and list conversion factors for specified effective dates [^r1][^r8]. All exchange rates recorded in this screen must originate from authorised finance office exchange sheets rather than public feeds [^r4].

## Fields

The screen requires three mandatory fields to define an exchange rate entry [^r1]:

| Field | Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| CUR CD | `cur_cd` | string | Foreign currency identifier [^r1][^r5][^r9]. |
| RATE DT | `rate_dt` | date | Effective date of the conversion rate [^r1][^r5][^r9]. |
| RATE TO GBP | `rate` | float | Conversion factor to GBP [^r1][^r5][^r9]. |

## Keys and services

Access is restricted to roles AP-CLERK, AP-MGR, FIN-CTRL, and SYS-ADMIN [^r8]. Screen operations are supported by [[services-ap-cur|AP cur services]] [^r9][^r11][^r12][^r13]:

* **Get (F3)**: Executes `cur_get` (CURRENCY RATE GET via `POST /ll72/svc/cur_get`) using CUR CD and RATE DT to verify or retrieve an existing conversion rate lodged for that currency and date, populating RATE TO GBP [^r2][^r6][^r9][^r11].
* **Save (F8)**: Invokes `cur_save` (`POST /ll72/svc/cur_save`) using `cur_cd`, `rate_dt`, and `rate` to commit exchange rates to GBP [^r9][^r13].
* **List**: Calls `cur_list` (CURRENCY RATE LIST via `POST /ll72/svc/cur_list`) to display historical recorded entries for the selected currency in reverse chronological order without clearing the active screen record [^r3][^r7][^r9][^r12].

## Messages

The screen reports error [[err-cur-0001|ERR-CUR-0001]] (Currency Rate Not Found) when a queried currency rate cannot be retrieved [^r10].

## See also

* [[services-ap-cur|AP cur services]]
* [[err-cur-0001|ERR-CUR-0001 Currency Rate Action Failed]]
* [[screen-ap-inv-01|AP-INV-01 Supplier Invoice Entry]]
* [[screen-ap-pay-03|AP-PAY-03 Payment Run]]

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Screen AP-CUR-13, menu Accounts payable > Currency rate. Services: cur_get, cur_save, cur_list.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Move the cursor to the RATE DT field and enter the calendar date for which the conversion factor applies. Press the cur_get button to execute the CURRENCY RATE GET service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 queries the central rate table held on the server. If a record matches the entered parameters, the system populates the RATE TO GBP field

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: If you wish to review a sequence of recorded entries across a broader range, press the cur_list button to invoke the CURRENCY RATE LIST service. The terminal displays a browse window listing historical currency entries associated with the selected foreign currency code, arranged in reverse chronological sequence.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Obtain the authorised exchange sheet issued by the finance office. The finance team provides the official conversion values agreed with the bank for the operational period. Never use unauthorized public feeds or approximate values taken from consumer finance notices.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Enter the relevant foreign currency identifier into the CUR CD field.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: The user then clicks cur_get to call CURRENCY RATE GET. This checks whether an existing rate has already been lodged for that currency on the specified date.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: Calling CURRENCY RATE LIST displays the historical entries without clearing the active record on the screen.

r8.quote: AP-CUR-13 CURRENCY RATE Menu: Accounts payable > Currency rate. Roles: [AP-CLERK, AP-MGR, FIN-CTRL, SYS-ADMIN].

r9.quote: CUR CD cur_cd str Yes RATE DT rate_dt date Yes RATE TO GBP rate float Yes

r11.quote:
service: cur_get
title: CURRENCY RATE GET
module: AP
kind: read
screen: AP-CUR-13

r12.quote:
service: cur_list
title: CURRENCY RATE LIST
module: AP
kind: read
screen: AP-CUR-13

r13.quote:
service: cur_save
title: CURRENCY RATE SAVE
module: AP
kind: write
screen: AP-CUR-13
